name: Codex CLI
description: Run AI-powered coding tasks on your local machine via the Codex CLI.

config_fields.label: Default Device ID
config_fields.description: Device to use by default (leave blank for auto-selection)

config_fields.label: Default Timeout (seconds)
config_fields.description: Maximum time to wait for a Codex task to complete

config_fields.label: Allowed Working Directories
config_fields.description: Comma-separated list of directories Codex is permitted to operate in

config_fields.label: Execution Profile
config_fields.description: Controls default risk tolerance for Codex operations

setup_instructions.title: Install the Codex CLI
setup_instructions.content: Run 'npm install -g @openai/codex' on each device where you want to use Codex. Verify with 'codex --version'.

setup_instructions.title: Enter your OpenAI API Key
setup_instructions.content: Paste your OpenAI API key in the field above. It will be stored encrypted and used to authenticate Codex CLI calls.

setup_instructions.title: Connect a Native Device
setup_instructions.content: Ensure at least one native device (desktop or server) is registered and online in the Devices panel.

setup_instructions.title: Test the Connection
setup_instructions.content: Ask an agent to run 'codex_check_runtime' to confirm the CLI is reachable on your device.
